title: I am struggling to get a SUMPRODUCT formula to work correctly in Excel. The goal
route_text:

My current formula is:

The bug: in `C15` the row range is `C3:N3` (1 row × 12 cols) while the criteria range `$A$3:$A$10` is 8 rows × 1 col. The two arrays are different shapes, so the multiplication broadcasts into an 8×12 array and the row-dimension term `(C3:N3)` gets paired against the wrong rows (blank rows 8–10) and against its own columns.

Fix: make both arrays the same shape — either the criteria range one row (`$A$3:$A$3`, since the row is fixed by the formula) or, keeping the full `$A$3:$A$10` list, use `INDEX($A$3:$A$10,COLUMN(C3:N3)-COLUMN(C3)+1)` so the criterion walks across the same columns as the values. Also wrap the values in `N()` so blanks count as 0 rather than making the range term blank.

Corrected formulas (live formulas, same sheet/styles):

- C15: `=SUMPRODUCT(--(MOD(COLUMN(C3:N3)-COLUMN(C3),4)=0)*INDEX($A$3:$A$10,COLUMN(C3:N3)-COLUMN(C3)+1)*(N(C3:N3)))` → 511 (row of 12365: C7=14, G7=260, K7=20 and the empty every-4th cells I3, E3 ... are 0; the old version wrongly also picked up 500 and 64 from other rows)
